name: fastspam
description: Weekly review of your Fastmail spam folder for mail that looks legitimate, on Cloudflare Workers

FASTMAIL_TOKEN.description: Fastmail API token with **Read-only access** (Settings → Privacy & Security → Manage API tokens → New API token → JMAP → Read-only access). Used to scan your Spam folder; it cannot change mail.

FASTMAIL_WRITE_TOKEN.description: Optional. A second Fastmail token with the **Email** scope, needed only for `NOTIFIER=fastmail` (the digest is appended to your Inbox) or `RESCUE_MAILBOX`. Enter `unused` otherwise.

POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN.description: Postmark Server API token, used when `NOTIFIER` is `postmark`. Enter `unused` otherwise.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Digest sender address. Postmark: a confirmed sender signature. Cloudflare Email: an address on your Email Routing domain. Fastmail: any address you own (shown as the From).

EMAIL_TO.description: Digest recipient address(es), comma separated. Ignored by `NOTIFIER=fastmail`, which files the digest straight into your Inbox.

DRY_RUN.description: `true` only logs the digest (good for a first run); `false` sends it.

TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone for dates in the digest, e.g. `Europe/London`.

AI_MODEL.description: Decision model: `@cf/cloudflare/clef` (default, runs on the free Workers AI allocation), `@cf/cloudflare/clef-flash`, `google/gemini-decision-1` or `openai/decisions` (the last two need `AI_GATEWAY_ID` and AI Gateway credits).

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: Optional AI Gateway name. Required for `google/gemini-decision-1` and `openai/decisions`.

FASTSPAM_STATE.description: KV namespace for fastspam's state (reviewed message ids, the Sent-recipient index, last run time). A new one is created for you.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email binding, only used when `NOTIFIER` is `cloudflare`.
